blockers.summary: Run the complete clean-checkout engineering matrix successfully: schema drift gate, Ruff, formatting, strict mypy, pytest, build, wheel/sdist install smoke, canonical JSON/Lattice conformance, and readiness checks. GitHub-hosted jobs currently fail before any step executes, so independent executable evidence is still required.

Complete the production conformance/adversarial corpus: canonical JSON/Lattice positive and negative vectors, compact-to-canonical equivalence, mutation/property/fuzz coverage, resource limits, migration ambiguity, permission-preservation, and unsupported-field fail-closed behavior.
A second independent implementation must consume the shared v0.1 vectors and reproduce canonical semantics/bytes for the frozen profiles.
Implement and verify the SLAI v2.3 integration target: pinned LSTP under SLAI/model/LSTP, SLAI-root run_lstp.py adapter, validation/conversion boundary, and end-to-end human/LANTRA/agent smoke tests.
Synchronize the Level-1 Whitepaper publication with the reconciled v0.1 contract, remove stale maturity claims, and produce a reproducible publication build/source-figure set.

Perform the final clean release/pre-training audit: compatibility/migration statement, package provenance, clean install evidence, conformance/interop/SLAI evidence, version freeze, and explicit training-ready sign-off.
